test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Banking Regulation Act, 1949 is a law that regulates banking firms in India. This Act was amendment by the Banking Regulation (Amendment) Act of which year?
solution:
The correct answer is "__**2020**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Minister of Finance**, Ms. Nirmala Sitharaman, presented the **Banking Regulation (Amendment) Bill, 2020**, in the Lok Sabha on March 3, 2020.
 
• The **Banking Regulation Act of 1949 **is being modified by the bill to include cooperative banks.
 
• The Act sets rules for how banks operate and gives information on a number of different topics, including **bank operations**, management, and licensing.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is "**2020**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Act does not apply to all cooperative societies. These are:

 
• Primary agricultural credit societies,
 
• Cooperative land mortgage banks, and
 
• Any other cooperative societies.

 
• ​According to the Bill, no one will be permitted to **seek payment** for the surrender of shares that a cooperative bank has issued to him. Furthermore, unless the **RBI** otherwise specifies, a **cooperative bank** is not permitted to withdraw or reduce its share capital.
